text: Based on the provided tool output, there was tree-cover loss of approximately 81.3 hectares within the asset in 2021. This loss was corroborated by later observations and agreed upon by the JRC 2020 reference for 98% of the event area. However, the output does not provide information about ongoing clearing activities beyond 2021. Therefore, it cannot be confirmed whether the forest on this property is still being cleared today.
